title: Clean-up after the one-time age exception (D-092): remove the source-map-js exclusion from apps/web/.npmrc and the exception entry from the web age gate, and bring the policy text back into line; not before 2026-10-07T14:08:09.382Z
objective: The one-time age exception for source-map-js 1.2.2 (owner directive D-092, task M0-T182) stopped applying by itself at 2026-10-07T14:08:09.382Z, when the version reached 604800 s. This task removes what it left, as the owner approved ('The installer exclusion is by package name only and does not expire, so it needs a second reviewed change to remove it', D-092-R016): (1) the `min-release-age-exclude[]=source-map-js` line and its comment in apps/web/.npmrc; (2) the exception from the web age checker apps/web/scripts/dependency_age_gate.mjs. THE ORCHESTRATOR'S DECISION ON HOW (for the G5 security reviewer to judge): the whole mechanism is removed, not only its one entry: the frozen list, the matching function, the result kind `owner_age_exception`, its report line and its tests. With the list emptied those would be code in a security gate that can never run and that nothing tests against a real entry; and the owner's words 'only this 1 time' say that no standing permission remains (D-092-R013). A later exception, if the owner ever approves one, is again a reviewed change that adds its own rule and its own clean-up, as M0-T182 and this task did. THE MEASURE: apps/web/.npmrc, apps/web/scripts/dependency_age_gate.mjs and apps/web/scripts/tests/dependency_age_gate.test.mjs become byte-identical to their content at the commit before the exception was added (`git diff 8fe57ca0^ HEAD -- <the three files>` is empty: no other commit has touched them since). If any line that M0-T182 added is NOT part of the exception (an unrelated improvement), the builder keeps it, says so and shows the difference. (3) docs/DEPENDENCY_SECURITY_POLICY.md: the three passages that describe the checker's mechanism say again that neither machine gate holds an exception path (restore the earlier sentences); the table 'Exceptions on record' STAYS as the dated record of the exception that was used, with its clean-up marked as done by this task and the date; the row of the enforcement map loses the temporary exclusion; section 6 keeps the rule that only the owner can authorize an age exception, for one named version, never for an advisory, and adds one sentence: an approved exception is implemented by a reviewed change to the gate that carries its own expiry and is removed by a second reviewed change (as D-092 was). WHAT STAYS: the exact pin of source-map-js 1.2.2 in apps/web/package.json and the lockfile, untouched; every other check of the gate (advisory, integrity, host, the 604800-second boundary). No package is added, removed or updated; the lockfile workflow is not run.
business_reason: Owner directive D-092-R016: the installer exclusion is by package name and does not expire by itself, so a second reviewed change removes it and the checker's exception entry. CLAUDE.md principle 15: every admitted version is at least 7 complete days old; the only exception is an owner-authorized, single-package, auto-expiring one. After this task no exception exists in either gate or in the installer setting.
